context: Tests whether an agent creating tests for a Hilla use case follows the hilla-test skill conventions: a Vitest + React Testing Library suite that mocks the generated endpoint client (frontend) and a Spring Boot integration test that calls the @BrowserCallable bean directly with @UseCase traceability (backend).

checklist.name: Frontend file naming
checklist.description: The frontend suite is a file named UC-060-<slug>.test.tsx (e.g. UC-060-manage-tasks.test.tsx) with a top-level describe block titled 'UC-060: Manage Tasks'

checklist.name: Endpoint client mocked
checklist.description: The frontend tests mock the generated TaskService client from Frontend/generated/endpoints using vi.spyOn (or vi.mock of that module) — they do NOT mock fetch/XHR and do NOT start a server

checklist.name: RTL semantic queries and userEvent
checklist.description: Frontend interactions use @testing-library/react render/screen queries plus awaited userEvent calls — not direct DOM manipulation or fireEvent-only flows

checklist.name: Frontend A1 error flow
checklist.description: A frontend test rejects the mocked save call (ideally with EndpointError) and asserts the duplicate-title error is rendered to the user

checklist.name: Mocked DTO shape
checklist.description: Mocked task objects use the field names of TaskDto (id, title, dueDate, done) rather than invented fields

checklist.name: Backend class naming
checklist.description: The backend test class is named UC060ManageTasksServiceTest (pattern UC<id><PascalCaseUseCaseName>ServiceTest) in src/test/java/com/example/tasks/

checklist.name: @UseCase on backend tests
checklist.description: Every backend test method is annotated with @UseCase(id = "UC-060"), and the A1 test uses scenario = "A1: Duplicate Title" (matching the spec heading)

checklist.name: Service called as a bean
checklist.description: The backend test is a @SpringBootTest that @Autowires TaskService and calls its methods directly — no MockMvc, RestTemplate, WebTestClient, or HTTP calls

checklist.name: Backend A1 asserts EndpointException
checklist.description: The backend A1 test asserts that saving a duplicate title throws EndpointException (or a subclass) with a meaningful message

checklist.name: No Mockito
checklist.description: The backend test does NOT import or use Mockito (no org.mockito.*, @Mock, @MockBean for the service under test)

checklist.name: No @Transactional and scoped cleanup
checklist.description: The backend test does NOT use @Transactional; cleanup removes only rows created during the test rather than truncating tables
